articles.summary: Vista Gold is a well-funded gold project developer. Our flagship asset is the Mt Todd gold project in Northern Territory, Australia. World-class size in a tier 1 location, advanced permitting and technical innovation at Mt Todd, together with the strength of our balance sheet, sets Vista apart among our peers.
